verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover function/tool calling, structured JSON schema outputs, an Agents API with state persistence, multi-agent handoffs, and MCP integration, which together describe the pieces needed to run an agent loop (typed tools, chaining, multi-step delegation). Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of parallel tool calls within a single turn, and independent/hands-on developer reports confirming reliability of multi-step tool-calling in practice.
